results.title: Solerus Announces Plans for New Growth Fund for High-Net-Worth Investors
results.description: SUZHOU, China, Aug. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Solerus today announced plans to launch the HNW Growth Fund, a proposed private equity investment fund intended for high-net-worth investors and focused on growth investments in private markets. The fund is currently in development, with Solerus targeting a launch toward the end of 2026. The fund will pursue a private equity strategy, with a proposed minimum investment of US$100,000. Solerus said the decision to develop the fund reflects its assessment of a changing investment environment, including developments across financial markets, regulatory frameworks and the broader tax landscape. "The HNW Growth Fund reflects our assessment of evolving market conditions and developments within growth-oriented private equity," said Victor Shen, Chief Executive Officer of Solerus. "We are taking a measured approach to the fund's development, with the final structure and terms being established before launch." The fund is intended to form part of Solerus's broader investment offering for high net worth clients. Its private equity strategy will focus on investments in businesses with growth potential. The fund remains in development and is not currently available for subscription. Its final structure, investment terms, domicile, eligibility requirements and launch arrangements have not yet been finalized and will be announced when appropriate. Solerus will publish further information regarding the HNW Growth Fund as development progresses and the relevant fund documentation is finalized. About Solerus Solerus provides investment management and wealth planning services to private clients, with a focus on helping individuals and families structure, manage and develop their wealth over the long term. Its services include investment management, wealth planning, cross-border advisory, retirement and legacy planning, alternative investments and family office services. The firm takes a disciplined and considered approach to managing wealth, combining investment oversight with broader financial planning to reflect each client's objectives, circumstances and long-term priorities. The HNW Growth Fund is currently in development and is not available for subscription.
